\section{\texttt{load\_or\_build\_index}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.factory.load_or_build_index}\index{Functions!load\_or\_build\_index}

Load the configured index, building it from data when needed.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
load_or_build_index(settings: Settings, *, telemetry: Telemetry | None = None) -> VectorStore
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings}, required.
  \item[\texttt{telemetry}] \texttt{Telemetry \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{VectorStore}
\apifield{Details}With the default \texttt{json} store the index is loaded from (or built and persisted to) \texttt{FEEDBACK\_\allowbreak{}AGENT\_\allowbreak{}INDEX\_\allowbreak{}PATH}. With \texttt{qdrant} the index lives in the configured Qdrant collection.
